response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development with strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, but his resume lacks direct experience with Java/Kotlin, Spring, or enterprise JVM tooling. His background in IDE development or language tooling is not evident, and his recent roles focus on web and AI-agent infrastructure rather than JVM ecosystems.
strengths: Strong background in software craftsmanship and clean code practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, refactoring dojos)
Experience with complex systems and large-scale codebases (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests)
Proven track record of technical leadership and mentorship (e.g., organizing workshops, creating courses)
concerns: No direct experience with Java/Kotlin or Spring framework, which are core requirements for the role
Limited exposure to JVM tooling or IDE internals in professional roles
Most recent roles focus on web/AI tooling rather than enterprise JVM development
